input_conditions: durable atomic blocks used within TestCase
tests run with TestCase (database transaction wrapping)
reproduction_steps: Use TestCase as base class for a test.
Include a durable atomic block (`atomic(durable=True)`) inside the test method.
Run the test (the durable atomic block executes without error).
Run the same code in staging/production without TestCase's transaction wrapping.
Observe a RuntimeError due to the durable atomic block not being at the outermost transaction level.
expected: The durability check should detect durable atomic blocks directly nested in a TestCase-created transaction and skip the durability error only for that specific scenario, allowing the test to pass without throwing a RuntimeError.
actual: Durable atomic blocks within TestCase do not raise a RuntimeError (the durability check is turned off), so durability errors go unnoticed until staging/production.
